# netactuate_vpc (Resource)

Manages a VPC.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_vpc" "example" {
  description = "example"
  label       = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) A description of the VPC (max 255 chars)
- `label` (String) The name of the VPC shown in the portal (max 32 chars)

### Optional

- `bastion_port` (Number) The bastion SSH port
- `enable_default_snat` (Boolean) If true, requests a default SNAT rule at creation time for outbound internet connectivity. This is a create-time convenience only -- the API has no persistent representation of it, so it can never be verified or recovered by Read/import; state simply keeps whatever value was last configured or defaulted. To manage SNAT rules as real, importable/driftable state, use netactuate_vpc_gateway_snat_rule instead.
- `firewall_ipv4_inbound` (Boolean) Enable IPv4 inbound firewall
- `firewall_ipv4_outbound` (Boolean) Enable IPv4 outbound firewall
- `firewall_ipv6_inbound` (Boolean) Enable IPv6 inbound firewall
- `firewall_ipv6_outbound` (Boolean) Enable IPv6 outbound firewall
- `location` (String) The location name to deploy the VPC
- `location_id` (Number) The location ID to deploy the VPC into
- `nameservers_ipv4` (List of String) IPv4 nameservers for DHCP
- `nameservers_ipv6` (List of String) IPv6 nameservers for DHCP
- `network_ipv4` (String) The IPv4 network CIDR available within the VPC (e.g. 10.0.0.0/24)
- `network_ipv6` (String) The IPv6 network CIDR available within the VPC
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `bastion_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the bastion is enabled
- `bastion_ipv4` (String) The bastion IPv4 address
- `bastion_ipv6` (String) The bastion IPv6 address
- `http_loadbalancer_count` (Number) How many HTTP load balancers exist in this VPC.
- `http_loadbalancer_id` (Number) The HTTP load balancer ID for this VPC. Empty when the API reports balancers as counts rather than identifiers.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `network_loadbalancer_count` (Number) How many network load balancers exist in this VPC.
- `network_loadbalancer_id` (Number) The network load balancer ID for this VPC. Empty when the API reports balancers as counts rather than identifiers.
- `status` (String) The overall status of the VPC
- `vpc_id` (Number) The ID of the VPC

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_vpc.example 12345
```
